about.title: About
about.freeBody: Rattil is and will remain free: no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no tracking.
about.privacy: Your data stays on your device. An account is only needed if you want to sync bookmarks.
about.sourcesNote: Quran text is never altered. The only display-time change is a glyph mapping so the bundled font draws open tanween correctly.
